'''Black Squadron''', also known as the '''61st squadron'''<ref name="TEGTWAC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-10-the-rise-of-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 10: The Rise of the Empire}} [[Cartha]] is identified as a pilot from the 61st squadron who served at the Battle of Yavin. Since there is no such squadron anywhere else, and Cartha has already been identified as a Black Squadron pilot, the two groups must be one and the same.</ref> and the '''Death Star Assault Squadron'''<ref name="CCG Death Star Assault Squadron">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Death Star Assault Squadron}}</ref> was an elite unit of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] pilots serving under [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] direct command.

==History==
[[File:GuardingTheWing-TCGDTF.png|thumb|left|320px|Black Squadron guarding the Death Star I]]
Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], members of the squadron, in particular Black Leader, Black 2, and Black 3, had been notoriously involved in various assaults on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] and [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], making them among the most feared squadrons used by the Empire.<ref name="CCG Death Star Assault Squadron" />

Stationed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Black Squadron was the TIE unit which Vader led into battle against the attacking [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] snubfighters&mdash;the only TIE unit to deploy against the Rebels during the battle. As Grand Moff Tarkin and most of the rest of the Death Star's chain of command refused to take the threat the Rebellion posed seriously, only the squadron that Vader personally commanded launched&mdash;fortunately for the Alliance, as the giant station carried several thousand TIEs that would have easily overwhelmed the few dozen [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighters]] the Rebels managed to throw against it. An element of six TIEs attacked the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] providing top cover, while Vader himself and two wing guards engaged the ships making the trench run. It is not often appreciated these TIE pilots were significantly outnumbered during the battle, but the members of Black Squadron were among the finest the Empire had to offer: they fought hard, and were responsible for many of the Alliance casualties.

The unit itself survived, and was later present for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

===Equipment===
All members of Black Squadron piloted the TIE/LN Starfighters, with the exception of Black Leader, aka Darth Vader, who instead piloted a [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|prototype TIE Advanced x1]] that had been personally designed by Vader.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'' includes both Black Squadron and [[Black Eight Squadron]] in the game.
